cover.headline: An agent edits and runs commands in all three repos.
cover.subhead: Keys in git, and AI work reaches main unreviewed.
cover.lede: Consolidated findings from audits of three Larkspur repos and the practice questionnaire, with a prioritised action plan.
cover.way_forward: Rotate the committed keys in orders-api and billing-service, cut the agent off production data, then commit one shared settings file and protect `main` in all 3 repos. One hardening week covers all four.

summary.title: Agents work in every repo, with few safety controls behind them
summary.lede: The agent edits files and runs commands in all three repos, and web-app already gives it a good instruction file and docs. The gaps are committed keys, AI commits reaching `main` without review and an agent that can read production data. The respondent knows most of the right practices; what is missing is the shared setup in the repos.

questionnaire.title: One respondent: strong on scenarios, weaker on briefs and follow-up
questionnaire.lede: Results are aggregates of one person's answers, asked once for the project. The Practice Score differs between repos only in how well the claims match each repo's audit.
notes: Two claims (tests before merge; a rule after a mistake) are contradicted in 2 of 3 repos, which lowers the score there.

actions.title: Seven actions: keys, production access, branches and guardrails first
actions.lede: Actions 1–4 close all 3 critical finding types and 3 of 4 high types; action 6 closes the last.

items.title: Rotate and remove keys
items.involves: Rotate the Stripe key (orders-api) and AWS key (billing-service); untrack `config/.env`; full-history secret scan in all 3.

items.title: Cut the agent off production
items.involves: Point the billing-service MCP server at a staging copy with no personal data; read-only role; pin its version.

items.title: Protect main
items.involves: PR with 1 non-author approval and required checks, no bypass, in orders-api and billing-service; CODEOWNERS for AI config.

items.title: One shared settings file
items.involves: Deny secret reads, force-push and push to default; block hooks and a secret-scan pre-commit; start from web-app's settings.

items.title: PR CI and a PR template
items.involves: Tests, lint and a secret scan on every PR in orders-api and billing-service; an "AI-assisted" box with test evidence.

items.title: One project AI policy
items.involves: Owner and backup, approved tools, data classes, MCP inventory; a full instruction file and skills for billing-service.

items.title: Better briefs, safer reading
items.involves: Add investigate-first and constraints to every agent brief; treat instructions found in files as data and flag them.
